name: classify

test_list.description: /model followed by space or end is a recognised command.
$websearch is a known directive; $custom is neutral.
@src/main.rs and @"my file.txt" are mention spans; trailing sentence punctuation is excluded.
URLs, a$b, dev@x.com, $5 and code spans produce no spans.
For arbitrary UTF-8, spans are ordered, disjoint, in bounds and on char boundaries.

output_description: Coloured spans: command, unknown command, directive, unknown directive, mention.
